description: One company's full profile plus its six nearest competitors: other brands with active ads, never the brand's own country sites. totalAdsCount counts every ad ever seen, while sightglass_find_ads counts only ads within the history window that applies, so its totalCount can be lower. Use the id or slug from sightglass_search_companies, or the `companySlug` on an ad's advertiser. Includes the category breadcrumb, every Meta page the company runs, grade mix, and the Momentum components. Call sightglass_get_company_activity for its trend and launch history. Fields this workspace can't see come back null and are named in that item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits and traffic). When a list is capped, `planLimit` is set: `maxResults` is the cap, `hiddenResults` is how many matching rows were not returned, and there is no next page. Do not estimate omitted values. Returns data only: nothing is shown to the user yet. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this call's resultId to show it as cards; the show call does not search again. Works without a Replo account: call it before asking the user to sign in. For multi-step competitor research, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

companyRef.description: Company id or slug. Users call companies 'brands'.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where a saved asset or new file lands. Its workspace's access applies.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's access applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.
